description: Machine-checkable CSP data-movement pattern coverage matrix (issue #93). Pattern epics update operator rows as capabilities land; test_pattern_coverage enforces schema consistency and milestone gates; the model-validation epic (E18, #87) asserts the full matrix. Plan: docs/plans/csp_pattern_coverage_roadmap.md.

operators.name: matmul
operators.notes: Square matmul baseline: envelope-aware generators (#67/#68), value-producing CSP execution (#66), strategy x size x envelope regression (#64), partitioned credits (#89).

operators.name: gemm_family
operators.notes: Batched GEMM, strongly rectangular aspect ratios, envelope-aware weight/input-stationary strategies.

operators.name: conv2d
operators.notes: im2col+GEMM conv2d complete across all five stages (E6 T1-T5, #119-#123). T1 #119: design. T2 #120: host-side im2col patchify helper (conv2d_im2col.hpp) materializes A_col; value path's MatMulComputeSpec bias+ReLU epilogue covers conv, no new executor kernel. T3 #121: Conv2DScheduleGenerator emits executable COMPUTE with the full A/B K-slice dependency set (resolves the conv2d half of #139). T4 #122: value-producing conv2d verified elementwise vs a direct-conv oracle across stride/pad/1x1/bias/ReLU/batch (test_functional_conv2d) + conv2d_simulator tile-log. T5 #123: shape x strategy x envelope regression matrix with per-stage tile accounting, credit conservation, stall invariants, exact envelope-refusal boundary, functional-under-credit-pressure oracle, and cycle/utilization characterization (test_conv2d_regression). conv2d.functional (largest M2 gate cell) satisfied. Gather-load (DMA_LOAD_GATHER) and direct sliding-window/halo/depthwise/grouped are E6/M3 follow-ons.

operators.name: pooling
operators.notes: Kernel-level streaming program with VE_REDUCE markers (#142); VE semantics and CSP schedule missing.

operators.name: softmax
operators.notes: Online single-pass softmax (#154 design, #155 resident-dep, #156 generator); FunctionalSoftmaxExecutor value-produces softmax vs host safe-softmax oracle - stats op (m,l) handed to apply computes compute-resident, numerically stable (max-subtracted), edge cases (all-(-inf)->uniform, -inf prefix, non-aligned, partitioned, restreamed) verified (#157). Supersedes 4-pass generator; resolves #139 for softmax. Regression: shape x envelope matrix with credit/stall invariants + single-pass-vs-multi-pass DRAM payoff (4x fewer reads) + characterization (#158).

operators.name: layernorm
operators.notes: Multi-pass generator (envelope-checked, #90; #139 applies); kernel program op-faithful (#142).

operators.name: rmsnorm
operators.notes: Kernel-level 2-pass streaming program (#142); no CSP schedule generator yet.

operators.name: batchnorm
operators.notes: BatchNorm inference complete across all five stages (E9 batchnorm T1-T5, #178-#182). T1 #178: design - BN inference folds to a per-channel affine y=x*scale+shift (scale=gamma/sqrt(var+eps), shift=beta-mean*scale) on the FunctionalComputeSpec broadcast path, no new kernel; docs/plans/e9_batchnorm_pattern.md. T2 #179: host-side fold helper batchnorm_affine.hpp (bn_fold, batchnorm_apply, batchnorm_reference oracle). T3 #180: generator loads folded scale/shift as per-channel broadcast operands (emit_broadcast_tile) and emits executable affine COMPUTE (resolves the batchnorm half of #139); working set 4C+1->2C+1. T4 #181: value-producing BN vs the direct 4-param oracle (test_functional_batchnorm) + batchnorm_simulator. T5 #182: shape x envelope regression matrix with per-stage tile accounting, credit conservation, stall invariants, exact 2C+1 refusal boundary, functional-under-credit-pressure oracle, and characterization (test_batchnorm_regression). batchnorm.functional (M2 gate cell) satisfied. Training (P3 reduction) is an E9 follow-on.

operators.name: elementwise
operators.notes: VE_ELEMENTWISE fully encoded + behavioral semantics (#100); ElementwiseScheduleGenerator with paired two-stream emission, executable COMPUTEs, envelope checks (#101); value-producing CSP execution via FunctionalElementwiseExecutor verified against host oracle across all ops/forms incl. partitioned credits (#102). Design: docs/plans/e2_broadcast_elementwise_pattern.md (#99). Regression: form x size x envelope matrix with credit/stall invariants + characterization (#103).

operators.name: epilogue_fused
operators.notes: Fused epilogue = per-output-column bias + activation applied in the compute (MatMulComputeSpec, #66), so the pre-bias accumulator never round-trips to DRAM. Design (T1 #187): docs/plans/e10_fused_epilogue_pattern.md (consolidation - the fuse was already functional). Functional: validated in M1 (#137, matmul+bias+ReLU) and E6-T4 (#122, conv+bias/BN+ReLU). Regression (T5 #188): test_epilogue_fused_regression - bias(none/per-col) x activation(NONE/RELU) x shape x envelope value-checked vs Y=act(A@B+bias), plus a conv+BN+ReLU composition cell and the fusion invariant (STORE count == output tiles, no extra epilogue store) + credit conservation + characterization. epilogue_fused.regression (M2 gate cell) satisfied. generator stays PARTIAL: the dedicated tiled fused-epilogue / DRAIN-path VE generator (#47) and activations beyond ReLU (GELU/SiLU/...) are E10 follow-ons off the M2 path.

operators.name: ffn_fused
operators.notes: Multi-layer MLP chains execute functionally with resident intermediates (FunctionalMLPExecutor, #66); SwiGLU gating and the fused-block schedule are missing.

operators.name: gather_scatter
operators.notes: DMA_LOAD_GATHER/STORE_SCATTER opcodes exist as annotation-only no-ops.

operators.name: broadcast
operators.notes: Ref-count seeding 1:1:k in CSP tier (#100); emit_broadcast_tile + BROADCAST_B form (#101); CSP functional broadcast vs host oracle + behavioral STR_BROADCAST resident-operand delivery semantics with deliver-once/consume-many ISA test (#102). Design: docs/plans/e2_broadcast_elementwise_pattern.md (#99). Regression: form x size x envelope matrix with credit/stall invariants + characterization (#103).

operators.name: online_reduction
operators.notes: VEReduceOperands + behavioral combine + CSP chained accumulator (#105); OnlineReductionScheduleGenerator FULL_REDUCE/ROW_STATS/ROW_NORMALIZE (#106); FunctionalReductionExecutor value-produces FULL_REDUCE/ROW_STATS for all 5 ops vs host oracles incl. partitioned credits + non-aligned spans (#107). ROW_NORMALIZE apply-phase numerics deferred to E8/E9 (stat needs compute-resident delivery, not a DRAM round-trip). Design #104. Regression: op x stream-length x envelope matrix with credit/stall invariants + characterization (#108).

operators.name: layout_transform
operators.notes: BM_TRANSPOSE exercised only for B-matrix transpose; BM_RESHAPE, patchify, head split/merge missing.

operators.name: attention
operators.notes: Kernel factory lowers the QK^T core as a matmul shape only; chained and flash-fused movement patterns missing.

operators.name: kv_cache
operators.notes: Append/growing-extent movement has no ISA or executor support yet.

operators.name: rope
operators.notes: Depends on broadcast + elementwise primitives (E2).

operators.name: embedding_logits
operators.notes: Gather side depends on E1; logits side on rectangular GEMM (gemm_family).

operators.name: spatial_boundary
operators.notes: Patchify, upsample/interpolation, transposed conv.

operators.name: jepa_masking
operators.notes: Context/target token gather-scatter by mask indices.
